title: Beyond Fences
description_en:
Champirolls — Beyond Fences (EP, 2026). Dark progressive / psy tech on Padang Records, Brazil.

no rules
no borders
beyond fences

a fence is a small god.

it stands in the dirt.
and tells the body where to stop.

wood, wire, law, fear, habit.
all of them speaking the same language

stay here.
move straight.
do not cross.

but something crawls under
something cuts through
something keeps walking after the map ends

beyond fences comes from that place

from the animal eye in the dark
from the hand on rusted metal
from the pulse that does not ask for a road

there is dust in the groove
pressure in the chest
a broken gate swinging somewhere behind the sound

no rules
no borders

only the step forward

only the body remembering
that open ground was never given

it was taken
credits:
All tracks written and produced by Julien Poujol
Artwork by 25m42
Master by SM Analogic Mastering UK

title: Hikari
description_en:
Falzar — Hikari (EP, 2026). Dark progressive / psy tech on Padang Records, Brazil.

light at the end of nothing

a gate
a path
a distant fire

hikari is not a destination
it is what pulls you forward

through silence
through shadow
through what cannot be named

falzar follows the glow

and the road remains open

title: Integrated
description_en:
Orbsynth — Integrated (album, 2026). Dark progressive / psy tech on Padang Records, Brazil.

there is a seed in the dark.

small, dense, loaded with force.

inside it, there is pressure.
no ceremony.
no answer.
pressure.

living matter pressed against its own shape, gathering heat before the shell begins to open.

integrated is born from that friction.

the individual appears as impulse, repetition, memory trapped in the body. something that turns, returns, insists. something searching for a base inside the noise and slowly finding its own frequency.

orbsynth builds this path with weight and texture.

the sound has a dark plastic surface, almost tactile. basslines move like underground machines. synthetic layers bend, stretch, compress. nothing gives itself away at once. everything seems to operate from within, as if each track were a closed room with mechanisms turning behind the walls.

integration comes as a physical process. gathering what was scattered. facing what has no name. sensing essence as a contact zone between instinct, shadow, body and perception.

there is a seed.
there is a base.
there is a tuning rising in the dark.
there is an unnamed field after the first rupture.
there are orbits changing without permission.
there are cycles returning altered.
there is a distant point where the whole design begins to appear.

integrated moves through this territory: the place where the fragment stops explaining itself and begins to take form.

No salvation

alignment

pressure becoming structure.

the inner machine opening like a flower made of stone, resin and light.
credits:
Mastering by SM Analogic Mastering UK
Artwork by Ymani

and the veils open.
Time bends,
form trembles,

title: Nyctophilia II
description_en:
Various Artists — Nyctophilia II (VA, 2026). Dark progressive / psy tech compilation on Padang Records, Brazil.

Nyctophilia is not the absence of light,
but the choice to remain
when light steps away.

It is the hour when sound gains power,
when rhythm sinks deeper,
and the mind opens its hidden rooms ~
where darkness becomes a warm place of rest,
not escape.

Here, frequencies carry weight,
and shadows feel familiar. ~
steady, patient, fluid.

This compilation moves through that inner realm.
Hypnotic structures unfold with intention,
deep atmospheres breathe in low registers,
and warmth emerges
not in spite of the darkness,
but because of it.

A terrain where introspection takes form,
where transformation happens without force unfolding all emotions naturally. 

Nyctophilia Vol. 2 traces the music’s tension
between shadow and glow,
revealing how beauty persists in both states ~
how stillness can illuminate & how the dark knows the way to water your seed.

Step in.
The dark is not to be feared.
credits:
Compiled by Rhabia
Master by SM Analogic Mastering UK

title: 2025 Anthology (Free VA)
description_en:
Various Artists — 2025 Anthology (free VA, 2025). 30 tracks of dark progressive / psy tech from the Padang Records roster, Brazil. Name your price.

They say the dance never ends.
Barong moves first — teeth, rhythm, protection.
Rangda moves after — the truth we avoid, the shadow that waits.

We spend our lives building temples of “good,”
painting our masks brighter,
hoping the darkness won’t recognize us.

But the darkness is the part of us that connects us to everything.
And when we finally turn to face it, it doesn’t destroy — it completes.

Here, the dance becomes a mirror.
A conversation.
A sacred argument.
A spiral toward wholeness.

2025 Anthology is offered freely —
a small blessing,
a thank you,
an offering of smoke left at the gate.

For everyone who has listened, shared, danced,
and kept Padang alive in the invisible places.

Take it.
Keep it.
Pass it on.

May it find you in the hour you need it.
And when the fog rises,
may you recognize yourself —
fully, finally —
in both the smile and the teeth.

— Dienstmann
Padang Records

title: Tekra
description_en:
MNGRM — Tekra (EP, 2025). Dark progressive / psy tech on Padang Records, Brazil.

Two figures drift toward one another,
formed not of flesh,
but of currents, vapors, and vanishing edges.
Twin faces meeting in a moment suspended—
a dialogue of mirrors
where self and shadow trade places
and neither one truly stays.

This is Tekra:
a dance of duality,
a collision of forces that flicker
between becoming and dissolving.
MNGRM moves through these states
as if tracing the outline of smoke—
shifting, slipping, returning,
never the same shape twice.

The music rises from that tension:
dark pulses bending like liquid metal,
textures breathing in slow spirals,
melodies coiling around each other
until you can’t tell which voice belongs to which side
or whether any side ever existed at all.

Impermanence is the only constant here.
We are brief sparks in a drifting world,
faces forming from mist
and fading back into it
before we have time to name ourselves.

Yet in this fleeting moment,
in this meeting of echoes and opposites,
something real emerges—
a truth held not in permanence,
but in the intensity of passing through.

Tekra is that passage.
A reminder that we are all dancers
made of breath and shadow,
flickering for an instant
before dissolving into the great,
unapologetic night.
credits:

Artwork by Ymani
Master by SM Analogic Mastering UK

title: Reborn: Echoes of the Forest
description_en:
Between breath and memory,
a quiet fracture opened—
the kind that shifts the weight of a heart
without asking permission.
From it rose a low pulse,
like the echo of a familiar step
coming from a place with no body left,
yet still pointing the way.

Nineteen artists felt this call.
Not as a message,
but as a soft heaviness in the chest,
a signal turning the soul back
toward its true direction.
They answered with sound—
roots pushing through shadow,
small lights cutting paths
where silence once ruled.

Reborn — Echoes of the Forest emerges from that movement:
dark progressive without ornament,
shaped by those who know the night teaches,
and that some presences remain
long after they depart.
Distinct voices
tuned by the same awakening—
the kind that comes when loss is faced
and life insists on continuing.

Here, the forest breathes deeply.
It holds the footsteps that came before,
guides the ones that follow,
and turns absence into direction.

Each track carries a spark of this rebirth,
each artist moves the darkness
a little closer to life.

Step in.
The forest is awake.
And its heart remembers.
credits:
Compiled by Vagner Donada (aka Tekmall)
Dedicated to the memory of Leandro Donada, his brother
Mastering by SM Analogic Mastering UK
Artwork by Fernando Fetex

title: Mind Echoes
description_en:
There are two brothers walking through the inner desert.
Two sons of the same flame,
born in the fold where silence breathes the deepest.
They carry on their skin the dust of ancient nights,
and in their hands — dream machines,
cracks of light that open when the world shuts its eyes.

And so they move…
down the endless hallway of creation,
listening to the underground murmur of things without names.
They slip through invisible doors,
touch walls made of wind,
stare into the dark like greeting an old friend.

From this crossing come three tracks,
three sonic serpents wrapped around the same ancestral trunk:
raw dark progressive,
stone-cut, unpolished,
no ornaments, no disguises,
only depth,
only truth,
only the pulse that comes before language.

They called it Mind Echoes —
but maybe it’s just the echo of something you’ve always known,
the reflection of what vibrates behind the bones,
a memory trying to return while dancing in the dark.

Close your eyes.
Listen with your body.
Let the brothers lead you through the corridors of the unseen.
Because every mind has echoes.
And some… never fade.
credits:
Master by NPM
Artwork by Ymani

title: Õtoto
description_en:
Conceived in Marseille and born from two years of introspection, Otǒto is the first solo statement of Falzar, a French artist whose sound drifts gracefully between light and shadow — just as the cover’s surreal landscape suggests.

The title, Otǒto — Japanese for little brother — reflects a deep human connection that transcends distance. In 2023, Falzar journeyed to Japan to visit his mentor and brother Félix (AIRI) and Erika Shiroyama, the painter behind this luminous artwork. Together, they became his Japanese family — a wellspring of creative resonance, friendship, and gratitude.

Erika’s oil painting captures the very soul of the EP: celestial eyes, oceanic layers, mountains dissolving into sky — a dialogue between dream and reality. It is a map of consciousness where every symbol breathes with sound. Each of the four tracks expands upon this visual mythos, shaping a world of contrasts: clarity and chaos, weight and lightness, contemplation and movement.

Through Otǒto, Falzar translates that experience into vibration — a ritual of frequencies that bridges Marseille and Kyoto, studios and sunsets. The collaboration with Green Waves emerges as a natural extension of this journey, adding organic texture and emotional gravity to the story.

This release marks not just a debut, but a revelation — a circle completed between brothers, mentors, and the unseen energies that connect us.
Otǒto is the younger voice rising to speak, carrying within it the echoes of love, discipline, and silence.
credits:
Master by SM Analogic Mastering UK
Artwork by @erika__shiroyama

title: Chronicles
description_en:
Green Waves — Chronicles (album, 2025). Dark progressive / psy tech on Padang Records, Brazil.

Across ten chapters, Chronicles is a map—drawn at night, folded by the dancefloor, creased by long drives and longer afterthoughts. Each track captures a meeting, a shift, a discovery. What started as fragments—faces, places, transmissions at the edge of sleep—returns here as rhythm and tone. The grooves move like fault lines: patient, pressurized, then suddenly open, revealing rooms inside the low end where details flicker and resolve.

Shaped within Padang Records’ shadow-lit terrain, Chronicles carries the Green Waves current—dark progressive with a quiet insistence, sub-bass that walks, percussion that thinks. Melodic threads surface like landmarks you recognize without recalling when you’ve been there; textures breathe in and out, trading weight for space, tension for glide. It’s music for late hours and clear minds, built to hold both the pulse of a floor and the focus of headphones.

Taken together, these ten pieces read like field notes from a longer journey: coordinates sketched in kick and drone, margins annotated with small revelations. Chronicles doesn’t spell out the path so much as invite you to travel it—to feel how encounters become grooves, how transformations become tone, how the road itself becomes the record you hear.
credits:
All Tracks written and produced by Artur Vilela
Master by SM Analogic Mastering UK

title: Revolution

Runehk — Revolution (album, 2025). Dark progressive / psy tech on Padang Records, Brazil.

Revolution doesn’t explode — it pulses.
A slow fire eating certainties,
a bassline that refuses silence,
a groove carving tunnels in the dark.

True revolution doesn’t scream slogans,
it bends bodies until ego dissolves.
It is molten metal turned frequency,
a clandestine tribe learning a new language in sub-bass.

Revolution is this:
one step firm, another deeper,
dancing until we become roots —
until the world notices, too late,
that the future began in the shadows.
credits:
Master by SM Analogic Mastering

title: Portal Space
description_en:
ortal Space cracks a door in negative vacuum and lets the pressure in. Greek producer Smokcid anchors the set in root dark progressive—raw, hypnotic, freaky—where oblique basslines grind against rubber-tight kicks and micro-percussion maps the room like star charts. Textures smear and reassemble in slow gravitational pulls; synths mutter in side-band ghosts, then bloom into cold flame. It’s the kind of low-light momentum that tightens pupils and stretches time without breaking the frame.

Cryptic coordinates flicker: binary constellations, dust-bright corridors, orbit decays written in static. Between pulses, the void whispers and the body answers. The groove behaves like a singularity—everything falls toward it, reshaped, lean, inevitable. Portal Space doesn’t ask to be entered; it folds the hallway until you’re already inside. Freaky, precise, and beautifully unforgiving.

MinimalTech Series Vol. 1, 'What Creates Illusion,' is a transformative V.A. compiled by Nidhi Singh, also known as Black 11. Hailing from India, Nidhi a multidisciplinary force in the nation's underground scene for over a decade.

This compilation marks a pinnacle of artistic exploration. It features thirteen alchemical tracks engineered not merely to challenge perception, but to rewire the listener's neural pathways. Drawing from Goa's rich psychedelic heritage while venturing into the uncharted sonic territories of the Thar Desert, each composition is a meditation on rhythm, space, and the very fabric of existence.

This is an inward journey, an invitation to explore the depths of consciousness and discover the profound connection between sound and self. Prepare for an auditory adventure that transcends the ordinary to reveal the extraordinary.

title: Fruits of Frequency
description_en: Peel back the membrane of consensus and taste the volatile ripeness of something not meant for daylight. Frequencies slither like vines through the cortex, dripping with bittersweet data. Textures shimmer—half-organic, half-machine—fermenting in subterranean rhythms that breathe and convulse. Sweetness is deceptive. Patterns loop, mutate, collapse. Time liquefies. Meaning ferments. What grows here has no name, only sensation. Bite deeper. Let the bloom take hold.

title: El Viaje Oscuro Del Alma
description_en:
This is not a map, but the territory itself—a sonic cartography for the nocturnal pilgrimage of the psyche. Herein lies a transmission broadcast from the event horizon of the self, a sequence of recursive rhythms and tenebrous hums designed to dislocate the listener from the anchor of the mundane.

Enter a labyrinth of chthonic bass and whispering static, where each beat is a footfall in a corridor of mirrors. This is an auditory ritual for the age of absurdity, a soundtrack for the elegant decay of certainty. Kilbee weaves a tapestry of phantom mechanics and ectoplasmic synth lines—a sound that is both surgically precise and beautifully delirious.

Let the somatic metronome guide you through landscapes of sublime dread and into the crepuscular architecture of your own inner world. El Viaje Oscuro del Alma is a key, a current, a cog in a machine you were already a part of.

Tune in. Dissolve. Proceed.

title: Predators
description_en:
“Predators: Paracoaster” by Rollercoaster and Paracozm confronts our role as humans—the relentless force consuming the Earth. This album reflects the uneasy truth that we prey on the very environment giving us life. Each track echoes with the tension of chasing profit and power at the expense of nature’s balance.

Yet beneath the haunting rhythms lies a glimmer of hope, urging us to break free from the predator’s path. There is a sense of awakening: a realization that if we open our eyes, we can choose to heal our home rather than destroy it. “Predators: Paracoaster” is a wake-up call, challenging us to shift our focus from conquest to care before we lose everything we call ours.

title: Spaceman
description_en:
From the remote depths of Sirius B, they perceived the colossal alarm reverberating throughout Earth’s atmosphere—a cryptic cosmic cry that defied human comprehension. Drawn by the planet’s trembling pulse, they found their first sanctuaries among ancient temples scattered across the globe, with Indonesia’s fabled shores serving as their initial gateway.

Their presence stirred an eerie hush across the land, blending curiosity with foreboding. Silent tongues spun unearthly melodies carried on invisible winds, drifting into the deepest corners of mortal consciousness like distant whispers from a nameless beyond.

Fear and fascination intermingled in humanity’s collective soul as this otherworldly alarm sounded an irreversible shift. Hope flickered amid the chill of the unknown, yet was overshadowed by a haunting sense of cosmic power at play. In each resonant chord, these visitors unraveled the boundaries between realms, luring humankind toward an uncertain dawn of unity—and revelation.

Music became their cryptic language; temples, their sanctuaries. Within those storied strongholds, primal energies converged, forging a spectral bridge across unfathomable chasms, illuminating a path that shimmered with both dread and promise.
credits:
All Rights Reserved
Writted and Produced by Aoos
www.smanalogmastering.com

"Cowcaine" delivers a delirious blend of hypnotic basslines, off-kilter grooves, and sonic mischief—perfectly distilling the madness that made Nikolaj a cult icon. Prepare for a head-first dive into warped rhythms, freaky melodies, and the thrilling edge where sanity slips away. Strap in; Psypox is here to blow your mind once again!

title: VA Nyctophilia
description_en:
Nyctophilia

And a seeker stood before the night and asked: “What is this longing I feel when the sun bows to the horizon? Why does my soul stir when the world is cloaked in darkness?”

And the night spoke, saying:

"You are not lost in the dark, but found. For in the absence of light, your spirit is no longer bound by the illusions of the day. Here, in the stillness, you remember. You become."

"This music is not of the world you know, nor is it of the silence beyond. It is the voice of the unseen, the rhythm of shadows stretching long, the whisper of the wind that knows no master. It moves like the tide, not to drown you, but to cleanse. It trembles like fire, not to burn, but to illuminate. It calls you forth, not as a prisoner, but as a dancer upon the threshold of all things hidden."

"Do not fear the night, for it is only another face of the beloved. And do not fear the sound, for it is but your own heartbeat echoed back to you. Step forth into the darkness, for here, you will find not an end, but a beginning."
credits:
Compiled by Rhabia

title: VA Yin and Yang Studio Gang
description_en:
VA Yin and Yang Studio Gang is a meticulously curated compilation by STiX, also known as Deepy Sidhu, an artist who defines herself beyond labels and predefined styles. Her unique approach reflects a creative freedom that transcends boundaries, exploring soundscapes that range from introspective to explosive, always with depth and authenticity.

This VA is a direct reflection of her artistic vision: a celebration of the duality of life and music, balancing contrasts like light and darkness, chaos and harmony. STiX dedicated years to assembling a selection of tracks that resonate with one another, crafting an immersive and captivating sonic experience. More than just a compilation, Yin and Yang Studio Gang is an invitation to explore the infinite possibilities of electronic music without labels, guided by the visionary spirit of a curator who refuses to be confined by conventions.

title: Fire In The Kitchen
description_en:
Reverse Osmosis arrives on Padang Records with Fire In The Kitchen, an offering of raw, unfiltered energy. Each track unfolds like a spark catching flame, deliberate and unpredictable, balanced between precision and chaos.

This is sound as an element—untamed, transforming everything it touches. It doesn’t seek to explain itself. It exists to be felt, to burn, to shift the air around it.

A quiet intensity underpins the work, a reminder that the fire within is both destruction and creation, a force to be reckoned with.
credits:
Artwork by Nitio
Master by NPM

title: Brake the Chains
description_en:
In the beginning, there were shadows.

Flickering, shifting, silent specters, dancing on the walls of a forgotten cave. Men and women, bound in chains of their own making, worshiping the echoes of a world they could not see. Blind to the fire, blind to the light, blind to the song calling them home.

But somewhere, deep within the hollow, a rhythm began to rise. A pulse. A beat. A whisper that turned to thunder. Break the Chains, it said. And some heard it.

They climbed. They crawled. Hands bloodied, minds shattered, hearts wide open. They left the shadows behind. They rose toward the unknown, toward the shimmering light of a new dawn.

Now, here we are—standing on the edge of the great divide. The cave behind us, the stars above us, the music inside us.

Do you hear it? The electric hum, the primal throb. Machines and humans, dancing in communion. Time dissolves. Chains shatter. A symphony of freedom, born from chaos, carrying us higher.

Step into the fire. Let it burn away the lies. Dance your way to truth.

The shadows are gone. The light is here. But the question remains:

Will you stay in the cave, or will you join us in the firelight of forever?
credits:
Master by NPM
Artwork by @joe_blastard

title: Tula
description_en:
‘Tula’ conceptualises 5 stages of progression; from the coming of the universe and planet Earth to the destruction and undoing of all life and beauty due to our incompetence and selfishness as a species, interpreted through Mayan mythology. 

The Mayans believed that their God of peace, the Feathered Serpent, had arrived from the Eastern Sea. He founded their cities, formed laws, taught them how to be civilised and peaceful and gave them the skills and knowledge needed to thrive as a civilisation while forbidding the practice of human sacrifice.

This enlightened rule of the Feathered Serpent was then brought to an end by the malevolent God, Smoking Mirror, whose nightmarish cult demanded human sacrifice. Smoking Mirror was associated with night, darkness and the sacred jaguar. A struggle of light and darkness took place at the ancient site, Tula. After battling each other for a number of years the Feathered Serpent was defeated and then driven out of Tula.

Along with great sadness he sailed off again in the direction from where he had come on a Raft Of Serpents. After his departure the blood-splattering rituals were reintroduced with vengeance.

The concept was inspired by Graham Hancock’s book ‘Fingerprints Of The Gods.’ The myth epitomises modern man’s intent to destroy our planet and sacrifice all living creatures despite the fact that we ourselves will not survive the aftermath, and deservedly so.
credits: Master by Georgi Mateev (Balthazar & JackRock)

title: Cosmic Visitors
description_en:
Cosmic Visitors

And the stars sighed,
the planets whispered,
and we, frail wanderers,
lift our ears to hear.

Aoos opens the door,
a lonely traveler on a road between worlds,
calling out to those who dare listen.
With fingers stretching beyond the finite,
he tunes into the crackling whispers of alien tongues,
messages pulsing from the far reaches
of a cosmos we pretend to understand.

Each beat,
a breath in the darkness,
each sound,
a ripple in the fabric,
pulls us deeper—
toward the edge of knowing,
toward that place where the mind melts
and we are no longer bound by the flesh.

This journey—
not for the faint of heart,
nor the tired of spirit—
opens wide the gates of inner space,
an echo of the vast unknown.
Exploration,
Connection,
Transcendence.
We are bound together in the pulse,
the hum of the universe,
in the soundscapes of deep-driving beats,
hypnotic as the void itself,
dark as the night that holds us all.

title: VA Haunted Spectre 4
description_en:
In the electric darkness where shadows dance and spirits whisper, we unveil the spectral symphony that is Haunted Spectre 4, the latest incantation in our revered dark progressive psytrance odyssey. This volume emerges from the abyss, a haunting mosaic of sound that promises to elevate your auditory journey to ethereal heights.

With an ensemble of sonic alchemists from every corner of the globe, embodies the very soul of the dark psychedelic voyage. Each track, a meticulously woven tapestry of intricate soundscapes and pulsating rhythms, beckons you to transcend the mundane and venture into realms unknown.

From the depths rise basslines that throb with primal intensity, entwined with melodies that shimmer like ghostly apparitions. This compilation is a hymn to the genre's profound richness, its capacity to stir the depths of emotion and awaken the spirit.

Contributions flow from both the venerable masters and the bold new voices of the scene, each one a testament to the unceasing evolution of dark progressive psytrance.

title: Ancestral Calls
description_en:
Prepare yourself for an auditory awakening with "Ancestral Calls," the newest release by the avant-garde psychedelic duo, Fughetta & Fugato. This collection of tracks carries listeners on a transcendent voyage through time and space, starting with the echoes of the Shuar people in the heart of the Amazon. It drifts eastward, touching the mystic whispers of East Asia, and bows to the serene enigma of the Buddha's land. The journey reaches its crescendo in the womb of humanity, Africa, where the ancestral pulse of culture beats strong and diverse.

"Ancestral Calls" is a kaleidoscope of sound: tango rhythms intertwine with African drum beats, Peking opera melds with experimental field recordings, groovy bass lines dance with human voices, all underpinned by symphonic undertones. This alchemical fusion creates a vibrant tapestry that ignites the soul. Fughetta & Fugato's compositions are more than music—they are an invitation to lose yourself on the dancefloor, to wander through realms of trance, and to revel in the rich, chaotic beauty of our collective human heritage.

Here, DJ Mallki, pirate of the electronic music tribes, summons 19 sonic wizards from the farthest reaches of the Earth. His craft is alchemy, turning air into gold, silence into symphonies, weaving the electric whispers of ancient gods through the veins of the new world.

This is the dance of the eternal, the carnival of ghosts and dreams where beats serve as both map and compass. As Mallki stirs the cauldron, the night itself leans in to listen. Each track is a trick, each note a spell, unveiling secrets not just to be heard, but to be experienced. Come—dive into these sounds and find the paths where legends venture.

title: Consciousness
description_en:
*Consciousness* by Marcio Pellizaro, known artistically as Soulid, is a profound exploration of the transformative experiences in the artist's life. Released under Padang Records, a label celebrated for its innovative and psychedelic approach to music, this album marks a significant turning point in Soulid's artistic journey.

Each track in "Consciousness" is a reflection of Soulid's personal evolution, influenced deeply by the birth of his child and his explorations with cannabis as a form of medicine. The album blends the mystical with the mundane, weaving a tapestry of sounds that delve into the depths of introspection and self-discovery.

The music resonates with the themes of rebirth and enlightenment, capturing the essence of Soulid's newfound perspectives. The tracks range from ethereal and contemplative to vibrant and awakening, mirroring the spectrum of emotions and realizations encountered in this phase of life.

"Consciousness" is not just an album; it's a journey through the layers of the mind and soul, set against a backdrop of captivating psychedelic soundscapes and rhythmic melodies. It's a testament to the transformative power of life experiences and a tribute to the never-ending quest for personal growth and understanding.

In true Padang Records style, this album breaks barriers, challenges norms, and invites listeners to embark on a journey of their own, exploring the depths of their consciousness. "Consciousness" is an ode to the awakening of the spirit and the continuous evolution of the self.

title: Brahmasutra
description_en:
In the realm where sound morphs into a spectral dance, "Brahmasutra" emerges. It's a trance, dark and deep, where each beat is a whisper from the abyss, each melody a cry of cosmic lore.

This EP, a journey through the starlit corridors of the mind, weaves a tapestry of rhythmic illusions. Like a shaman of sound, conjures visions, blending the ancient and the digital into a symphony of psychedelic dreams. "Brahmasutra" is not just music; it's a gateway to transcendence, a hymn to the unseen, echoing in the cathedral of the soul.

title: Far Beyond Time
description_en:
In a dreamscape woven beyond the veil of time, where the universe hums an ancient lullaby, there exists a place untouched by the ticking hands of earthly clocks. This is a realm where the very essence of existence resonates with the pulse of an unseen heartbeat, a cadence that echoes through the cosmic corridors.

Here, the stars whisper secrets in a language older than light, each syllable a fragment of eternity itself. The dance of celestial bodies is not just a spectacle of the cosmos, but a poetic ballet choreographed by the invisible forces that bind galaxies.

In this dimension, the Earth is but a distant echo, a fleeting memory adrift in the cosmic sea. The rhythms here speak of truths unfathomable to the mortal mind, tales spun from the fabric of the universe, stories written in the stardust of forgotten worlds.

This is a journey into the heart of the unknown, a voyage across the ocean of the stars. Each moment is an eternal breath, a sigh of the universe as it contemplates its own infinite expanse. The music here is not composed of notes, but of the very essence of life and light.

In this boundless expanse, time loses meaning, and reality blends with fantasy. This is a place where dreams and reality converge, where the soul can dance freely, unbound by the constraints of temporal existence. It is a symphony of the cosmos, a song sung by the universe itself, inviting all who listen to join in the timeless dance of existence.
credits: Artwork by Ymani Design

title: Dual Nature
description_en:
Dualism isn't just a concept; it's the raw, pulsating essence of our enigmatic existence. Trapped in vessels of flesh and bone, we are governed by the cold, mechanistic laws of the physical realm. Yet, our minds dance on the edges of reality, defying the tangible and venturing into the mystic.

Who dares define what is saintly or sinister, what is luminescent or shrouded in darkness? Our choices are guided by our own intricate web of beliefs, and we tread an eternal tightrope between two diverging realities.

These creations don't merely explore dualism—they revel in it, twisting frequencies and rhythm into a shadowy ballet of contrasts. Dive into the abyss with low, growling frequencies, only to be lifted by intoxicating grooves that offer a not-so-innocent invitation to a unique and immersive labyrinth of sound.

title: Adam Adama
description_en:
Qawa Beat, a musical mystic with 25 years of experience and a legacy as the founder of Jaira Records, crafts this celestial journey, weaving the very fabric of existence into sound. Released under Padang Records, "Adam Adama" is an odyssey through time and space, connecting the earthly with the galactic.

A cosmic reflection of ourselves, this album explores the boundaries of Psychedelic, Jazz, Minimal, and Deep Tech, resonating with the heartbeat of the universe. It's an exploration of what it means to be human, a meditation on our place within the infinite, and a celebration of our profound connection to the natural world.

Each note is a step on a path that leads back to the source, back to the earth from which we came. Each melody is a ripple in the cosmic pond, a call to the ancient and the eternal.

"Adam Adama" invites you to dance with the unknown, to lose yourself in the labyrinth of sound, and to find yourself in the silence that follows. It's a journey to the core of existence, where music becomes a living force, a guide, a reflection of our primal nature.

In the hands of Qawa Beat, "Adam Adama" transcends music; it becomes a mirror to our souls, a bridge between the seen and the unseen, a sacred communion with the essence of life.

Join the odyssey. Embrace the mystery. Connect with the earth, with the stars, with yourself.

title: Virtuous Spiral
description_en:
In the echoing abyss of the sonic universe, where rhythm becomes the heartbeat of the spectral void, a new auditory journey spirals out from the heart of the Patagonian wilderness. Chilean artist Bensaid forges this voyage in the form of "Virtuous Spiral," an EP birthed in an unusual studio sanctuary, nestled amongst the ancient whispering trees.

Every pulsating beat within "Virtuous Spiral" echoes the symbiosis of the artist and his elemental surroundings, an intimate dialogue between creation and creator. The EP reverberates with a raw energy that dances on the feral edge of the techno spectrum, entwining the haunting melancholy of the forest’s voice in each track.

Yet, "Virtuous Spiral" transcends the boundaries of an auditory experience. It's an enigmatic invocation of the cosmos, of chaos and order, and of the primal dance of existence. Unfurling like the spiraling arms of a galaxy, the EP draws the listener into its hypnotic orbit, inviting them to traverse its labyrinth of sound, and to discover within its depths the profound, unspoken poetry of existence.

title: Surfing in Oscillations
description_en:
Life is a journey replete with unexpected turns and diverging paths, embodying a rhythmic dance of good and bad times. These opposing moments are not merely random occurrences, but part of a cyclical, dynamic progression that demands balance, resilience, and an unwavering spirit. With his latest release, 'Surfing in Oscillations', Artur Vilela, known in the electronic music community as Green Waves, paints a vivid sonic tapestry that mirrors this complex life journey.

'Surfing in Oscillations' is an enthralling three-track EP that encapsulates the essence of life's oscillations - the tranquil and the tumultuous, the serene and the stormy. Vilela crafts each track with masterful precision, infusing them with progressive dark elements that carry listeners through a captivating exploration of life's transitions. His unique style is both evocative and powerful, pushing the boundaries of progressive dark genre while staying true to his artistic identity.

Artur Vilela, a rising star in the progressive dark scene, continues to surprise and impress with his innovative approach to music production. His work with Padang Records further solidifies his commitment to creating engaging, original compositions that resonate with listeners on a deeply personal level. As Green Waves, he rides the pulse of life's ebb and flow, turning these universal experiences into a riveting auditory narrative.

This is more than just an EP release - it is a celebration of life's perpetual oscillations and the beauty that lies within its unexpected transitions. Join Green Waves as he navigates these rhythmic currents, surfacing from the depths of the psyche to the exhilarating crest of emotional expression, manifesting in 'Surfing in Oscillations'.

title: Mirror Me
description_en:
With Mirror Me, RNDM delivers a raw, unfiltered take on techno that's sure to get pulses racing and heads nodding. Each track is a sonic assault on the senses, filled with dark, brooding beats and hypnotic, layered textures. It's the kind of music that takes you on a journey, whether you want to go there or not.

But Mirror Me is more than just a collection of tracks. It's an exploration of the human psyche, a sonic mirror that reflects the deepest, darkest corners of the mind. RNDM draws on a wide range of influences.

A testament to Julien dedication to the underground music scene, and his willingness to push boundaries and challenge conventions. If you're a fan of cutting-edge electronic music that's not afraid to get a little weird, then Mirror Me is a must-have addition to your collection. So buckle up and get ready for a wild ride - RNDM is taking you on a trip you won't soon forget.

description_en:

The EP weaves together elements of the Nommo story, including the figures of the Hunter, the Weaver, and the Seed, to create a sonic exploration of the cosmos. From the pulsing beats of "Orion" to the haunting melodies of "Epsilon," ORION ep offers a unique and immersive experience for electronic music fans.
Monococ and Mrmsoun6 have expertly crafted an EP that pushes the boundaries of electronic music. ORION is a must-listen for anyone looking for a dynamic and otherworldly music experience.

title: Terra Infinita

In the depths of the infinite cosmos lies a world unlike any other. A world where darkness reigns and the light of hope is but a distant memory. This world is known as Terra Infinita, and it is the inspiration for the latest release from Padang Records.

The mastermind behind this dark and progressive journey is none other than the talented Mexican artist, Deuteroz. With his impeccable production skills and a keen eye for storytelling, Deuteroz takes listeners on a sonic journey through the twisted, ethereal landscapes of Terra Infinita.

From the ominous opening track to the haunting finale, Deuteroz weaves a tale of despair, hopelessness, and ultimate redemption. The music is a perfect blend of haunting melodies, pulsating rhythms, and atmospheric soundscapes that transport you to another world.

Terra Infinita is not just an album, it's a journey. A journey through a world where light and darkness collide, where hope and despair are in constant flux. So come, join Deuteroz on this epic adventure and explore the endless depths of Terra Infinita.

title: Xaman
description_en:
Quetzalcoatl journeyed to Mictlan in the Fifth Sun in order to restore humankind to life from the bones of those who had lived in previous eras. For bones are like seeds: everything that dies goes into the earth, and from the earth new life is born in the sacred cycle of existence.

Quetzalcoatl approached the Lord of Mictlan, where he sat on his throne surrounded by spiders and owls. "I've come for the bones, the precious bones, the jade bones," said Quetzalcoatl. "Can I have them in order to populate the earth?"

Only unwillingly did the Lord of Mictlan gives his assent. "You may take away that which I guard so carefully on one condition - that you parade four times around my throne blowing on this trumpet." And he handed Quetzalcoatl a conch shell that had no finger holes. But worms bored the fingerholes, and bees flew inside to make a sound.

Even so, Quetzalcoatl knew that he'd better move quickly to take the bones and leave. And sure enough the Lord of Mictlan gave orders that the bones be recovered. Quetzalcoatl thought of a trick. "Tell the Lord I'll leave the bones behind," he said to his nahual, his spirit twin. Accordingly the nahual, looking just like Quetzalcoatl himself, assured the Lord of Mictlan that the bones would be left. Meanwhile Quetzalcoatl began to run. Unfortunately, the Lord of Mictlan ordered that a pit be dug in the fleeing god's path, and sure enough he fell into it, having been startled by a covey of quail. Those bones that weren't already shattered were pecked at by the quail. Which is why humans come in all sizes.

"This has not worked out well," said Quetzalcoatl to his spirit twin.

"What must be must be," replied the nahual. And so Quetzalcoatl scooped up the bones and, once safely beyond the dead land, ground them up in a bowl. Together with other gods, he sprinkled them with his own blood, restoring them to life. And thus humankind was born from the pennance of the gods themselves.

title: Mars Music
description_en: Andreas Valdes Maida, a.k.a Flix was a lucky motherfucker that had the possibility, super early in life, to meet General MIDI and serial ports. So, hella geek, more than being a virtuous musician, started getting into computers, keyboards, and weird noises. Lots of things happened since the day he got his first computer. Lets just jump to 2006 when he fell in love with psychedelic music, Earthdance Festival in Chile opened this young dude eyes and ears to another possible world full of opportunities, so in 2010 slowly started producing his own tunes, after some years making psytrance under the name Andyflip, and behind the project Reptilian Renegades, and besides playing the sinthesizers for the psychedelic rock band Spiral Vortex, this 27 years old producer from Chile is glad to anounce his first release on Padang records.
